name: auto-test
description: Automatically runs tests after every code generation turn. If tests fail, provides feedback to the agent for self-correction.
author: Qwen Code AI Engineering

afterTurn: After generating code, run the test suite. If tests fail, report failures with specific file/line info to enable self-correction. If tests pass, report coverage stats.
onResume: Re-run tests to verify the codebase is still in a valid state after session resume

test_commands.fallback: echo 'No test command configured for this project'
